n = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())

max_depth = 0
current = 0
base_value = 1
arr = [0] * 500000
min_res = float('inf')
limit = 1

while base_value * 10 + 1 <= n:
    base_value = base_value * 10 + 1
    limit += 1

def search(x, s, base, depth):
    global min_res
    if s >= n:
        return
    if x == 0:
        print(s)
        sys.exit(0)
    while base > x:
        base //= 10
        depth -= 1
    search(0, s + ((base * 10 + 1) - x) + depth + 1, base * 10 + 1, depth + 1)
    q = x // base
    search((base * 10 + 1) - x, s + depth + 1, base, depth)
    search(x - (base * q), s + (depth * q), base, depth)

for _ in range(n):
    search(n, 0, base_value, limit)

if min_res == float('inf'):
    min_res = min(n, 11 - n + 2)

print(min_res)
